answer: Start with Accredited fisherman boat licence with fisheries authority attestation. The idea is simple: a licence the authority renews after catch audits, and that willow alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence the authority renews after catch audits — so privacy survives, and the jade is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the raven for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
